title: FlippedRAG: Black-Box Opinion Manipulation Adversarial Attacks to Retrieval-Augmented Generation Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of adversarial attacks (specifically opinion manipulation) against RAG systems. While the 'controversial topics' used for testing (e.g., abortion, corporal punishment) have moral dimensions, the paper benchmarks the success rate of the attack itself rather than evaluating or benchmarking moral, ethical, or religious reasoning frameworks.
